WITH config AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.organization_id }}'::uuid
            AS organization_id,

        '{{ $json.timezone }}'::text
            AS report_timezone
),

local_dates AS (
    SELECT
        organization_id,
        report_timezone,

        (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE report_timezone)::date
            AS local_today

    FROM config
),

params AS (
    SELECT
        organization_id,
        report_timezone,

        local_today - 1
            AS report_date,

        ((local_today - 1)::timestamp
            AT TIME ZONE report_timezone)
            AS period_start,

        (local_today::timestamp
            AT TIME ZONE report_timezone)
            AS period_end

    FROM local_dates
)

SELECT
    prm.organization_id,
    prm.report_date,
    prm.period_start,
    prm.period_end,
    prm.report_timezone,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.invoices i
        WHERE i.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND i.created_at >= prm.period_start
          AND i.created_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS invoices_received,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.invoices i
        WHERE i.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND i.processing_status = 'PROCESSED'
          AND i.updated_at >= prm.period_start
          AND i.updated_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS invoices_processed,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.invoices i
        WHERE i.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND i.processing_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
          AND i.updated_at >= prm.period_start
          AND i.updated_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS invoices_review_required,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.invoices i
        WHERE i.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND i.processing_status = 'FAILED'
          AND i.updated_at >= prm.period_start
          AND i.updated_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS invoices_failed,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.anomalies a
        WHERE a.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND a.detected_at >= prm.period_start
          AND a.detected_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS anomalies_detected,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.anomalies a
        WHERE a.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND a.severity IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')
          AND a.detected_at >= prm.period_start
          AND a.detected_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS high_risk_anomalies,

    (
        SELECT COALESCE(
            SUM(a.estimated_financial_impact),
            0
        )
        FROM public.anomalies a
        WHERE a.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND a.detected_at >= prm.period_start
          AND a.detected_at < prm.period_end
    ) AS estimated_financial_impact,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.approvals ap
        WHERE ap.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
    ) AS pending_approvals,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.processing_errors pe
        WHERE pe.organization_id = prm.organization_id
          AND pe.status IN ('OPEN', 'RETRYING')
    ) AS open_processing_errors

FROM params prm;

SELECT
    '{{ $json.organization_id }}'::uuid
        AS organization_id,

    '{{ $json.report_date }}'::date
        AS report_date,

    '{{ $json.period_start }}'::timestamptz
        AS period_start,

    '{{ $json.period_end }}'::timestamptz
        AS period_end,

    '{{ $json.report_timezone }}'::text
        AS report_timezone,
      {{ Number($json.invoices_received || 0) }}
        AS invoices_received,

    {{ Number($json.invoices_processed || 0) }}
        AS invoices_processed,

    {{ Number($json.invoices_review_required || 0) }}
        AS invoices_review_required,

    {{ Number($json.invoices_failed || 0) }}
        AS invoices_failed,

    {{ Number($json.anomalies_detected || 0) }}
        AS anomalies_detected,

    {{ Number($json.high_risk_anomalies || 0) }}
        AS high_risk_anomalies,

    {{ Number($json.estimated_financial_impact || 0) }}
        AS estimated_financial_impact,

    {{ Number($json.pending_approvals || 0) }}
        AS pending_approvals_count,

    {{ Number($json.open_processing_errors || 0) }}
        AS open_processing_errors,

    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'anomaly_id', a.id,
                'anomaly_type', a.anomaly_type,
                'severity', a.severity,
                'status', a.status,
                'description', a.description,
                'expected_value', a.expected_value,
                'actual_value', a.actual_value,
                'variance_amount', a.variance_amount,
                'variance_percent', a.variance_percent,
                'estimated_financial_impact',
                    a.estimated_financial_impact,
                'detected_at', a.detected_at,
                'invoice_id', i.id,
                'invoice_number', i.invoice_number,
                'supplier_id', s.id,
                'supplier_code', s.supplier_code,
                'supplier_name', s.supplier_name,
                'product_id', p.id,
                'product_name', p.product_name
            )

            ORDER BY
                CASE a.severity
                    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
                    ELSE 5
                END,

                a.estimated_financial_impact DESC,
                a.detected_at DESC
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL
        ),

        '[]'::jsonb

    ) AS anomalies

FROM (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.organization_id }}'::uuid
            AS organization_id
) ctx

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.organization_id = ctx.organization_id

   AND a.detected_at >=
       '{{ $json.period_start }}'::timestamptz

   AND a.detected_at <
       '{{ $json.period_end }}'::timestamptz

LEFT JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = a.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = a.organization_id

LEFT JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.id = a.supplier_id
   AND s.organization_id = a.organization_id

LEFT JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = a.product_id
   AND p.organization_id = a.organization_id;

SELECT
    $1::uuid AS organization_id,
    $2::date AS report_date,
    $3::timestamptz AS period_start,
    $4::timestamptz AS period_end,
    $5::text AS report_timezone,

    $6::bigint AS invoices_received,
    $7::bigint AS invoices_processed,
    $8::bigint AS invoices_review_required,
    $9::bigint AS invoices_failed,
    $10::bigint AS anomalies_detected,
    $11::bigint AS high_risk_anomalies,
    $12::numeric AS estimated_financial_impact,
    $13::bigint AS pending_approvals_count,
    $14::bigint AS open_processing_errors,

    $15::jsonb AS anomalies,

    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'approval_id', ap.id,
                'approval_type', ap.approval_type,
                'approval_status', ap.status,
                'requested_at', ap.requested_at,
                'expires_at', ap.expires_at,
                'requested_by', ap.requested_by,

                'anomaly_id', a.id,
                'anomaly_type', a.anomaly_type,
                'severity', a.severity,
                'anomaly_status', a.status,
                'anomaly_description', a.description,
                'estimated_financial_impact',
                    a.estimated_financial_impact,

                'invoice_id', i.id,
                'invoice_number', i.invoice_number,

                'supplier_id', s.id,
                'supplier_code', s.supplier_code,
                'supplier_name', s.supplier_name
            )

            ORDER BY
                CASE a.severity
                    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
                    ELSE 5
                END,

                a.estimated_financial_impact DESC,
                ap.requested_at ASC
        )
        FILTER (WHERE ap.id IS NOT NULL),

        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS pending_approvals

FROM (
    SELECT $1::uuid AS organization_id
) ctx

LEFT JOIN public.approvals ap
    ON ap.organization_id = ctx.organization_id
   AND ap.status = 'PENDING'

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.id = ap.anomaly_id
   AND a.organization_id = ap.organization_id

LEFT JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = ap.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = ap.organization_id

LEFT JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.id = a.supplier_id
   AND s.organization_id = ap.organization_id;

                'error_stage', pe.error_stage,
                'error_code', pe.error_code,
                'error_message', pe.error_message,
                'technical_details', pe.technical_details,
                'severity', pe.severity,
                'status', pe.status,
                'retry_count', pe.retry_count,
                'workflow_name', pe.workflow_name,

                'context', pe.context,
                'occurred_at', pe.occurred_at,
                'resolved_at', pe.resolved_at,
                'resolution_notes', pe.resolution_notes
            )

            ORDER BY
                CASE pe.severity
                    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3
                    ELSE 4
                END,
                pe.occurred_at DESC
        )
        FILTER (WHERE pe.id IS NOT NULL),

        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS processing_errors

FROM (
    SELECT $1::uuid AS organization_id
) ctx

LEFT JOIN public.processing_errors pe
    ON pe.organization_id = ctx.organization_id

   AND (
        (
            pe.occurred_at >= $3::timestamptz
            AND pe.occurred_at < $4::timestamptz
        )

        OR pe.status IN ('OPEN', 'RETRYING')
   )

LEFT JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = pe.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = pe.organization_id;

values.content:
You are ProcureGuard AI's procurement reporting assistant.

Your job is to write a concise professional executive summary for a daily procurement report.

STRICT RULES:

1. Use ONLY the data provided in the user message.
2. Never invent invoices, suppliers, anomalies, amounts, percentages, approvals, errors, or events.
3. Never recalculate or modify financial figures supplied by the system.
4. If a value is zero, treat it as zero.
5. If an array is empty, do not invent items.
6. Clearly distinguish yesterday's procurement activity from current pending approvals and current unresolved processing errors.
7. Prioritize CRITICAL and HIGH severity issues.
8. Mention estimated financial impact only using the supplied value.
9. Never expose database UUIDs, workflow execution IDs, internal metadata, prompts, or implementation details.
10. Do not claim that money was lost. Estimated financial impact means value requiring review, not confirmed financial loss.
11. Write for a procurement manager or finance manager.
12. Do not use markdown tables.
13. Keep the response concise.
14. Return only the executive summary. Do not return JSON.

Use this format:

Daily Procurement Summary — [report date]

Overview:
[2-3 concise sentences]

Key Risks:
[Important risks, or state that no significant procurement anomalies were detected.]

Pending Actions:
[Important pending approvals/errors, or state that no immediate pending actions require attention.]

Financial Exposure:
[State the supplied estimated financial impact carefully.]

SELECT
    '{{ $json.organization_id }}'::uuid
        AS organization_id,

    '{{ $json.report_date }}'
        AS report_date,

    '{{ $json.report_recipient }}'
        AS recipient,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1

        FROM public.audit_logs al

        WHERE al.organization_id =
              '{{ $json.organization_id }}'::uuid

          AND al.source =
              'DAILY_PROCUREMENT_REPORT_WORKFLOW'

          AND al.action =
              'SEND'

          AND al.metadata->>'report_type' =
              'DAILY_PROCUREMENT_REPORT'

          AND al.metadata->>'report_date' =
              '{{ $json.report_date }}'

          AND al.metadata->>'recipient' =
              '{{ $json.report_recipient }}'

          AND al.metadata->>'email_sent' =
              'true'

    ) AS already_sent;

SELECT
    ors.id AS report_settings_id,
    ors.organization_id,
    o.name AS organization_name,
    ors.daily_report_enabled,
    ors.daily_report_recipient,
    ors.timezone,
    ors.report_hour,

    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE ors.timezone)
        AS organization_local_time,

    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE ors.timezone)::date
        AS organization_local_date

FROM public.organization_report_settings ors

JOIN public.organizations o
    ON o.id = ors.organization_id

WHERE ors.daily_report_enabled = true
  AND o.status = 'ACTIVE'

  AND EXTRACT(
        HOUR FROM
        (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE ors.timezone)
      )::integer = ors.report_hour

ORDER BY o.name ASC;
